senses.exPt: Vou grelhar um peixe para o jantar.

senses.def: a piece of equipment for cooking food over heat
senses.ex: We cooked the burgers on the grill.
senses.exPt: Fizemos os hambúrgueres na churrasqueira.

senses.def: cooked over or under strong direct heat
senses.ex: I'll have the grilled chicken with salad.
senses.exPt: Vou querer o frango grelhado com salada.

senses.def: a shop that sells food and things for the house
senses.ex: I'm going to the grocery store to buy some milk.
senses.exPt: Vou ao mercado comprar leite.

senses.def: a man on his wedding day
senses.ex: The groom was very nervous before the wedding.
senses.exPt: O noivo estava muito nervoso antes do casamento.

senses.def: the surface of the earth that you walk on
senses.ex: I dropped my keys on the ground.
senses.exPt: Deixei as chaves caírem no chão.

senses.def: the floor of a building at the same level as the street
senses.ex: The reception desk is on the ground floor.
senses.exPt: A recepção fica no térreo.

senses.def: a number of people or things together
senses.ex: We worked in groups of four in class today.
senses.exPt: Hoje trabalhamos em grupos de quatro na aula.

senses.def: a set of people or things put together
senses.ex: The teacher changed the groupings for the next project.
senses.exPt: A professora mudou os grupos para o próximo projeto.

senses.def: to become bigger or taller
senses.ex: Children grow very fast at this age.
senses.exPt: As crianças crescem muito rápido nessa idade.

senses.def: to put plants in the ground and look after them
senses.ex: My grandmother grows tomatoes in her garden.
senses.exPt: Minha avó planta tomates no quintal dela.

senses.def: an increase in size, number or importance
senses.ex: The city has seen rapid growth in recent years.
senses.exPt: A cidade teve um crescimento rápido nos últimos anos.

senses.def: a written promise to repair or replace a product if it breaks
senses.ex: The TV comes with a two-year guarantee.
senses.exPt: A TV vem com garantia de dois anos.

senses.def: to promise that something will happen
senses.ex: I can't guarantee that he'll be there.
senses.exPt: Não posso garantir que ele vai estar lá.

senses.def: a person whose job is to protect a building or the people in it
senses.ex: A security guard stopped him at the door.
senses.exPt: Um segurança o parou na porta.

senses.def: a soldier or police officer who protects a place or a person
senses.ex: There are guards outside the palace.
senses.exPt: Há guardas do lado de fora do palácio.

senses.def: to give an answer when you do not know if it is right
senses.ex: Can you guess how old I am?
senses.exPt: Você consegue adivinhar quantos anos eu tenho?

senses.def: to think that something is probably true
senses.ex: I guess you're right about the price.
senses.exPt: Acho que você tem razão sobre o preço.

senses.def: a person you invite to your home or a party
senses.ex: We have twenty guests coming to the wedding.
senses.exPt: Temos vinte convidados vindo para o casamento.

senses.def: a person staying at a hotel
senses.ex: The hotel pool is only for guests.
senses.exPt: A piscina do hotel é só para hóspedes.

senses.def: help or advice about what to do
senses.ex: Students can get guidance from their teachers about careers.
senses.exPt: Os alunos podem receber orientação dos professores sobre carreiras.

senses.def: a person who shows tourists around, or a book with information
senses.ex: Our guide showed us around the old city.
senses.exPt: Nosso guia nos mostrou a cidade antiga.

senses.def: to show someone the way
senses.ex: She guided us through the forest to the lake.
senses.exPt: Ela nos guiou pela floresta até o lago.

senses.def: a book with information for tourists about a place
senses.ex: The guidebook says the castle opens at nine.
senses.exPt: O guia diz que o castelo abre às nove.

senses.def: the bad feeling you have when you know you did something wrong
senses.ex: He felt a lot of guilt about lying to his mother.
senses.exPt: Ele sentiu muita culpa por ter mentido para a mãe.

senses.def: feeling bad because you did something wrong, or having broken a law
senses.ex: I feel guilty about forgetting her birthday.
senses.exPt: Eu me sinto culpado por ter esquecido o aniversário dela.

senses.def: a musical instrument with six strings that you play with your fingers
senses.ex: My brother is learning to play the guitar.
senses.exPt: Meu irmão está aprendendo a tocar violão.

senses.def: a person who plays the guitar
senses.ex: He is the guitarist in a rock band.
senses.exPt: Ele é o guitarrista de uma banda de rock.

senses.def: a weapon that fires bullets
senses.ex: The police officer had a gun.
senses.exPt: O policial estava com uma arma.

senses.def: an informal word for a man
senses.ex: Who's that guy talking to your sister?
senses.exPt: Quem é aquele cara conversando com a sua irmã?

senses.def: guys: an informal way to talk to a group of people
senses.ex: Hi guys, sorry I'm late again!
senses.exPt: Oi, pessoal, desculpa o atraso de novo!

senses.def: a place with machines where people go to exercise
senses.ex: I go to the gym three times a week.
senses.exPt: Eu vou à academia três vezes por semana.

senses.def: a large room in a school for sports and games
senses.ex: The school basketball game is in the gym tonight.
senses.exPt: O jogo de basquete da escola é no ginásio hoje à noite.

senses.def: a sport with exercises that show strength and balance
senses.ex: She has been doing gymnastics since she was five.
senses.exPt: Ela faz ginástica desde os cinco anos.
